meta.notes: Mixed: 11 features are real 2024 replacement values from the Town of Orangeville 2024 Development Charges Background Study, Watson & Associates, Tables B-13 to B-15 (https://www.orangeville.ca/en/doing-business/resources/Documents/Town%20of%20Orangeville%202024%20D.C.%20Background%20Study%20-%20Final%20Report.pdf), converted to our units where stated in each source. Features without a 'source' (trail lighting, parking, tree planting, plaza, community garden, outdoor rink) are still illustrative sample prices. Generated by scripts/build-real-prices.ts.
